scope: Labelled origin supplements for December calendar names whose reviewed history gives no origin.
method: thin151.mjs 12-01 12-31 listed reviewed December histories without origin wording; r162-data.mjs + build-r162.mjs (generated by makebuild.mjs from the round 151 helpers and the O-blocks of rounds 152–162) wrote public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements-r162.js, merged by public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements.js. Lithuanian comparison names in two-stem notes are checked against the LT calendar (lt2check.cjs). Skipped: names whose reviewed history already explains the word (Raita, Volfs, Valdemars, Iveta, Gaisma group, Lelde, Minjona, Helmārs, the explained Lithuanian two-stem names, Leino, Kalli, Kulla, Vambo, Sulvi, Piiu), names without a secure base (Elmāra, Gaja, Nina, Eularija, Vidas, Aiver, Ethel, Iivi, Taave). Rounds 159–162 share writer 1.9.132 and the audit research/namedays/round162-audit.json. Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).
